description: A strongly-typed language that compiles to JavaScript

latest_release.name: v0.15.17
latest_release.body:
## New features

* Add attached `derive` clauses to `data` and `newtype` declarations (#4594 by @i-am-the-slime).

  Derivable instances can now be declared directly after a type declaration:

  ```purescript
  data Color = Red | Green | Blue
    derive (Eq, Ord)

  newtype Name = Name String
    derive (Eq, Ord)

  data Box a = Empty | Full a
    derive (Functor)
  ```

  Attached clauses support the compiler’s built-in deriving mechanisms and can be used alongside standalone `derive instance` declarations. They do not support `derive newtype`.

## Bugfixes

* Keep inlined `Data.Int.Bits.zshr` results within the signed 32-bit `Int` range (#4597 by @thomashoneyman).

  Zero-fill right shifts of negative inputs by zero or a multiple of 32 now return the original signed input instead of an out-of-range unsigned value. Nonzero effective shift counts retain zero-fill semantics. Code relying on `zshr x 0` as an unsigned conversion will change behavior.

## Internal

* Fix `CoreFn.Traversals.traverseCoreFn` so it recurses correctly into `Let` bodies (#4561 by @drathier).
* Switch from the unmaintained cryptonite library to its maintained fork, crypton (#4596 by @f-f).
* Replace the retired macOS 14 ARM64 CI runner with macOS 15, retaining macOS Intel coverage (#4598 by @thomashoneyman).
* Fetch test dependencies from verified registry tarballs and exercise their published `purs.json` manifests, retaining Bower publishing compatibility tests (#4599 by @thomashoneyman).
